bannerTitle: A new version of harbard is available
bannerDone: harbard has been updated. Reload to see the new version.
restartingHint: The bus is restarting. This takes a few seconds.
doneHint: The new version is installed. Reload the page to use it.
doneCurrent: You're already on the new version.
runningHint: You can keep working; harbard restarts itself when ready.
noNotes: This version has no notes; the list of changes is below.
channelMainHint: Tells you as soon as something new lands on the main branch.
channelReleasesHint: Tells you only when a numbered version comes out.
problemNoCheckout: harbard's repository copy can't be found on this Mac, so it can't be updated from here.
problemDirty: The repository copy has unsaved changes. Save or discard them before updating.
problemNotOnMain: The repository copy isn't on the main branch. Switch to main before updating.
problemDiverged: Your main branch has commits that aren't on the remote. Push them or move them to another branch before updating.
errorFetchFailed: Couldn't download anything from the remote. Check your connection and that you have access to the repository.
errorStepFailed: An update step failed; the log has the reason.
errorInterrupted: The update was cut off partway. You can try again.
errorLocalOnly: You can only update from the console on this Mac.
errorRoleForbids: This device can't update harbard; do it from the Mac acting as the hub.
errorFallback: Something went wrong during the update.
statusNoServe: Can't tell whether there are new versions: harbard isn't responding.
statusNeverChecked: No check for new versions has run yet.
statusUpToDate: You're up to date. Last checked: {when}.
checkingRepository: Checking the repository for new versions…
truncatedHint: And more changes that don't fit in this list.
channelLegend: What counts as a new version
autoCheckHint: harbard checks the repository every six hours without installing anything. Installing is always up to you.
repoHint: The copy of harbard on this Mac that each version is built from.
